name: @singularity/plugin-debug-trace-engine
description: The generic slow-event trace engine: the TraceEventClass contribution registry, captureTrace() admission + coherent-instant capture + async enrich/persist, the durable traces table (fed to live readers by an in-process change producer), the debug.traces list window and debug.trace lookup, sweep job, and the Trace.Lane / Trace.TriggerSummary web dispatch slots.
